BiblicalUsage: Picol was the chief captain of Abimelech's army, a Philistine commander. He stood beside Abimelech when the covenant was made with Abraham at Beer-sheba in Genesis 21:22 and Genesis 21:32, and came again with Abimelech to Isaac in Genesis 26:26.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a Philistine general could see God was with Abraham — and said so to his face.
